main.description: Confirm a Checkout the caller came back from, so the account's subscription is current before Stripe's webhook arrives. Confirming twice changes nothing. Customers only.

sessionId.description: The Checkout Session id Stripe put on the return URL.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID the client generates once per request and resends on every retry of it. Only a success is kept against it: after a refusal, retrying with the same key runs the request again.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not a HappyProto customer, or the provisioner refused them.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: sessionId or idempotencyKey is missing or malformed, or the provisioner refused the request as malformed.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: InvalidSlug
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: SlugTaken
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: NotEntitled
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: InstanceLimit
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: NoCapacity
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: OperationInProgress
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: AccountSuspended
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: PlanNotOffered
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: PaymentRequired
errors.description: No subscription covers this yet: start a Checkout (billing.createCheckout).

errors.name: AlreadySubscribed
errors.description: The account already has a subscription: create the instance directly.

errors.name: CardRequired
errors.description: A trial without a card covers one instance: add a card (billing.createPortalSession) for more.

errors.name: BillingHold
errors.description: The account is on hold (its trial ended without a card, or payments failed) until its card is added or fixed.

errors.name: TrialPoolFull
errors.description: Every trial place without a card is taken: a Checkout with withCard starts now.

errors.name: CheckoutNotComplete
errors.description: Stripe hasn't finished the Checkout yet. Retry shortly; the same idempotencyKey may be reused, since a refusal releases it.

errors.name: CheckoutExpired
errors.description: The Checkout expired. Start another.

errors.name: NoBillingAccount
errors.description: The account has no billing account yet: start a Checkout first.

errors.name: NoSubscription
errors.description: The account has a billing account but no plan running, so there is nothing to cancel.

errors.name: PaymentFailed
errors.description: The card was declined. Updating the card and retrying pays the same open invoice.

errors.name: PaymentActionRequired
errors.description: The bank wants the payment confirmed (3D Secure); Stripe emails the owner a link.

errors.name: BillingInProgress
errors.description: Another resume or Checkout start for the account is running. Try again shortly.

errors.name: CardChanged
errors.description: The card changed during the charge attempts. Retry.

errors.name: ClosedBetaNotBilling
errors.description: A closed-beta account asked for a Checkout before closed-beta billing has started.

errors.name: BillingUnavailable
errors.description: Billing is switched off, or unavailable for now.

errors.name: InvalidCode
errors.description: No such waitlist code.

errors.name: CodeUsed
errors.description: That waitlist code has been used.

errors.name: CodeExpired
errors.description: That waitlist code has expired.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers.

billing.description: The account's subscription. Absent while billing is off, or doesn't apply to the account.

status.description: The subscription's status; none before the first Checkout.

exempt.description: Staff exempted the account from billing.

hasPaymentMethod.description: A usable card is on file. While a trial has none, the account's instances run at Hobby resources.

trialEndsAt.description: When the trial ends and the first invoice is due.

billingStartsAt.description: When the first charge is due, for a closed-beta account whose billing starts later.

currentPeriodEnd.description: When the current billing period ends: the subscription renews then, or ends if cancelAtPeriodEnd.

discountStage.description: Where the account is in its closed-beta discount, when it has one.

plans.description: The plans the subscription bills, with a quantity each.

clamped.description: A trial without a card: the account's instances run at Hobby's resources, seats and log retention until a card is added.

cohort.description: Which beta the account joined in.

closedBetaBillingStarts.description: When closed-beta accounts start paying. Absent until it's set; until then they can't subscribe.

reserved.description: Held for the account by a Checkout.

applied.description: Its credit is on the account.

hold.description: The account's instances are stopped until a card is added or fixed.

reason.description: trial_paused: the trial ended without a card. payment_failed: payments failed past the retries. canceled: the subscription ended; a new Checkout restarts it. closed_beta_ended: a closed-beta account reached its billing start without subscribing; a Checkout restarts it.

at.description: When the hold began. The instances' data is kept for 30 days from then.

actionRequired.description: A payment the bank wants confirmed (3D Secure). The subscription stays paused until it's paid.

invoiceUrl.description: Stripe's page for the open invoice, where the owner confirms the payment.
